content: I'll have a get together with my friends tomorrow. Could you tell me what to wear Lucy?
How about this red T-shirt Mark? It can make you look active.
Oh, red makes me tense. I'd rather wear the yellow T-shirt.
Because it makes me feel relaxed and look confident.
Ok, perhaps you should wear a black hat and blue jeans.
You mean a yellow T-shirt with a black hat and blue jeans? That's a good choice.
Yeah, you must be a star at the party.
